license_note: Both weight repositories (MiniMax-M1-40k and MiniMax-M1-80k) carry a standard Apache License 2.0 LICENSE file beside the weights, the model cards declare apache-2.0, and the GitHub repository carries the same Apache-2.0 text, so the release is open-licensed with no field-of-use restriction, unlike the MiniMax Model License on the preceding Text-01 release.

license_evidence.scope: MiniMax-M1 model weights and repository files in the MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M1-80k and MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M1-40k Hugging Face repositories and the MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-M1 repository

access_boundary: This record represents the MiniMax-M1 reasoning release as the pair of checkpoints MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M1-40k and MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M1-80k, both last modified 2025-07-07. The MiniMax-Text-01 base, the transformers-native -hf conversions, the M2 and later M-series models, downstream quantizations, and the MiniMax Open Platform are separate boundaries.
strengths: Standard Apache-2.0 text beside the weights in both checkpoints and in the GitHub repository, with no field-of-use clause
The model card and repository document vLLM and Transformers deployment guides, function calling, and a technical report
tradeoffs: The 456B-parameter checkpoints need multi-GPU serving, and the release ships in two thinking-budget variants that a user must choose between
The current MiniMax platform documentation does not list M1, so no first-party hosted endpoint is documented today
